title: Freelance Project Pricer
description: Build a project quote from hours times rate plus expenses plus a profit margin.
howto: Enter estimated hours and your hourly rate.
Add any out-of-pocket expenses (software, travel, subcontractors).
Set your profit margin percentage on top of costs.
Read the recommended quote, profit amount, and effective hourly rate.

faqs.q: Should margin apply to expenses too?
faqs.a: Yes, in this tool the margin is applied to total cost (labor plus expenses), which protects you when expenses are large.

faqs.q: What margin should a freelancer use?
faqs.a: Many freelancers add 10-30% depending on risk and demand. This is a business judgment, not a rule.

faqs.q: How is the effective hourly rate useful?
faqs.a: It shows what you really earn per hour after expenses and margin, which you can compare with your target rate.
